objects.name: HelpText
objects.string: Arrows: fly. Collect the 10 stars, then reach the station.

content.text: Arrows: fly. Collect the 10 stars, then reach the station.

events.comment: The radar (top right) turns with the ship and shows the enemies and the station. The map (bottom left) shows the whole level. The objects shown on them have the "Minimap marker" behavior, with a color, a shape and a category.
The enemies chase the ship when it is near, and patrol otherwise.

tests.name: Radar and map show the markers
tests.description: The radar shows the two enemies near the ship and the far station on its edge; the map shows every object of the level.
source: harness.assert(shown('Radar').length === 3, 'The radar shows 2 enemies and the station: ' + shown('Radar').length);
harness.assert(shown('LevelMap').length === 34, 'The map shows every object: ' + shown('LevelMap').length);

tests.name: Collecting a star
tests.description: Flying to the right collects the star in front of the ship: the counter goes up and its marker leaves the map.
source: harness.setKeyPressed('Right', true); await harness.stepFrames(50); harness.setKeyPressed('Right', false); await harness.stepFrames(3);
harness.assert(shown('LevelMap').length === before - 1, 'Its marker leaves the map: ' + before + ' -> ' + shown('LevelMap').length);

eventsFunctionsExtensions.name: Minimap
eventsFunctionsExtensions.shortDescription: A minimap or a radar showing the player, the enemies, the items... as colored markers.
description: Show objects on a minimap (or a radar):

1. Add the "Minimap marker" behavior to the objects to show, and choose the color, the shape (dot, square, triangle, diamond, star, ring) and the size of their marker. Check "Center of the minimaps" on the player.
2. Put a minimap on a layer of the interface. It shows the area around the player, or a fixed area of the scene (for example the whole level).
A minimap can be round or rectangular, turn with the player like a radar, show only some categories of markers (like "Enemy"), and keep far markers on its edge (like a quest objective).
Ready-to-use minimaps and radars in many styles are in the asset store [minimaps pack](https://editor.gdevelop.io/?initial-dialog=asset-store&asset-pack=minimaps-and-radars-minimaps).

eventsBasedBehaviors.description: Show the object on the minimaps (and radars) of the scene, as a marker of a color and a shape.

Add this object to the markers of the frame.

propertyDescriptors.label: Shape
propertyDescriptors.name: Shape
propertyDescriptors.description: The shape of the marker. A triangle points in the direction of the object, when "Rotate with the object" is checked.

propertyDescriptors.label: Category
propertyDescriptors.name: Category
propertyDescriptors.description: For example "Enemy" or "Item". A minimap can show only some categories.

propertyDescriptors.label: Show on the edge when out of range
propertyDescriptors.name: ShowOnEdge
propertyDescriptors.description: When the object is too far to be on the minimap, its marker stays on the edge, in its direction (like a quest objective).

propertyDescriptors.label: Rotate with the object
propertyDescriptors.name: RotateWithObject
propertyDescriptors.description: Useful with the triangle shape, to show where the object goes.

propertyDescriptors.label: Center of the minimaps
propertyDescriptors.name: IsCenter
propertyDescriptors.description: The minimaps that follow a center follow this object (usually the player). Only one object should have it.

eventsBasedObjects.description: A minimap or a radar, showing the objects that have the marker behavior as colored dots, squares, arrows... around the player or on a fixed area of the scene.
eventsBasedObjects.name: Minimap

propertyDescriptors.label: Shape of the minimap
propertyDescriptors.name: Shape
propertyDescriptors.description: Markers are kept inside a circle or a rectangle.

propertyDescriptors.label: Shown area
propertyDescriptors.name: Mode
propertyDescriptors.description: "Follow": the area around the object whose marker is the center of the minimaps (usually the player). "Fixed area": a fixed area of the scene, for example the whole level.

propertyDescriptors.label: Visible range
propertyDescriptors.name: VisibleRange
propertyDescriptors.description: With "Follow": the distance in the scene from the center to the edge of the minimap.

propertyDescriptors.label: Rotate with the center object
propertyDescriptors.name: RotateWithCenter
propertyDescriptors.description: With "Follow": the minimap turns so that the center object always goes up, like a radar.

propertyDescriptors.label: Categories shown
propertyDescriptors.name: Categories
propertyDescriptors.description: Leave empty to show every marker, or list categories separated by commas, like "Enemy,Item".

propertyDescriptors.label: Padding
propertyDescriptors.name: Padding
propertyDescriptors.description: Space between the markers and the border of the minimap.

propertyDescriptors.label: Speed of the radar sweep
propertyDescriptors.name: SweepSpeed
propertyDescriptors.description: In degrees per second (if the minimap has a sweep).

eventsFunctions.description: Change the categories of markers shown on the minimap: categories separated by commas, or an empty text to show every marker.
